data.one_liner: A lightweight state management library inspired by Riverpod, providing concise, testable business logic.
data.what_it_does: Creator offers a simple API to create reactive state streams and async emitters. It automatically manages dependencies, lazy loads providers, and rebuilds widgets when state changes.
use_when: Require async support without complex boilerplate
Want easy testing of business logic
avoid_when: Large, complex apps with many interdependent providers
Projects that rely heavily on code generation or advanced features like routing
strengths: Automatic dependency graph and lazy loading
weaknesses: Less mature ecosystem, fewer third‑party integrations
No built‑in code generation or advanced features

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: More mature, extensive ecosystem, and built‑in async support

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Popular, well‑documented, and integrates with Bloc pattern
